Verified on candidate 0fea8adf by reading ADR-0053 against the code. ADR-0053 §2 now has a dated T-DG6-ARCH-15 paragraph, 'Optimistic concurrency of acknowledge and resolve'. §2 'Refusal codes' and §9 'Every mutation' point to it, and putServiceIdentity keeps the strict rule. Each stated rule matches apps/api/src/modules/operations/exceptions.ts. rebaseOverSystemOccurrences returns null on an equal version. It gives 409 for a version that is not an integer, below 1 or ahead of the row. It accepts a version behind the row only when there are exactly (current - loaded) events in (loaded, current] and each is 'recurred' with actor_user_id null; anything else is 409. basedOn writes changes.based_on_version {from, to}. In acknowledgeException, recheckAtCommit runs before the version rule and the state refusals run after it. The behaviour itself is tested by exception-recurrence-race.test.ts, which passes 7/7 (bez8.log). This is a documentation finding, so a revert mutant does not apply.
